name: Genie
tagline: Run your business from a conversation on your phone

roadmap.note: Sees everything - briefings, bookings, requests, money, reviews, the activity trail - and acts on it: send quotes and invoices, manage bookings, block out time. Every action behind a confirmation card only you can tap, with a receipt on the audit trail.

marketing.summary: Ask your business anything: what happened today, who is waiting on you, what is unpaid, what is booked tomorrow. Genie reads everything your workspace knows and answers in plain sentences, on your phone, between jobs.
marketing.audience: Owners who want the day's picture without opening five screens.

features.title: The morning briefing
features.body: One tap: what happened, what is booked, who is waiting, what is unpaid.

features.title: It cites, not guesses
features.body: Every answer comes from your workspace's own records and the activity trail - the same one you can check.

features.title: Actions with a receipt
features.body: Send a quote or invoice, cancel or complete a booking, block out your time - from the chat. Every action shows you a card first, and nothing happens until you confirm it.

faq.a: Only what you confirm. Genie proposes an action as a card - send this invoice, cancel that booking - and it executes only when you tap confirm. Every action lands on the activity trail with a receipt.
